windows.text: Reach the open gripper horizontally toward the stove burner.
Reach the open gripper horizontally toward the black knob on the stove.
Approach the stove knob from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Approach the stove knob from above, lowering the open gripper down toward it.
Approach the stove knob from above, lowering the open gripper to position it for turning.
Grasp the black knob on the stove by closing the gripper fingers around it.
Hold the gripper steady above the stove burner to maintain contact with the control knob.
Hold the gripper stationary above the stove burner to maintain contact with the control knob.
Hold the gripper stationary above the stove burner.
